html:
King of Dahomey from 1718 to 1740, who conquered the coastal kingdoms of Allada in 1724 and Whydah in 1727, giving Dahomey direct access to European traders.

With the port of Ouidah, Dahomey became one of the largest sellers of captives in the Atlantic slave trade. Agaja's wars brought the cavalry of Oyo down on Dahomey several times, and from 1730 Dahomey paid tribute to Oyo for almost a century. Tradition credits him with organising the royal army and a network of spies. See also Abomey.
